services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Ready to throw a party your guests will never forget? Charter The Tropics and turn your celebration into a floating waterfront experience! With our 126-passenger, double- decker catamaran all to yourselves, the entire boat becomes your private party playground. Cruise the Clearwater waters, chase the sunset, blast your favorite playlist, and celebrate in style. Want to follow one of our popular cruise routes? Create your own? Head somewhere special? We’re all in. Birthdays, bachelorettes, weddings, corporate parties, family reunions - if it calls for fun, it belongs on the water.
